architectural_decisions.decision: Use python-telegram-bot v21+ with ConversationHandler and concurrent_updates(False)
architectural_decisions.reason: Ensures deterministic conversation state transitions and prevents race conditions in stateful flows.
architectural_decisions.impact: High stability for multi-step forms like adding routers or generating cards.
architectural_decisions.review_trigger: If telegram throughput requirements exceed 100 updates/sec per bot instance.

architectural_decisions.decision: Centralize all RouterOS commands in core/ and wrap via connection_pool.py
architectural_decisions.reason: Avoids connection exhaustion on MikroTik devices and provides automatic retries/throttling.
alternatives: Direct raw librouteros sockets in handlers
architectural_decisions.impact: Decouples Telegram UI from MikroTik transport errors and enables offline testing.
architectural_decisions.review_trigger: If router pool concurrency limits hit maximum capacity.

architectural_decisions.reason: Allows graceful database schema evolutions in production without dropping user databases.
architectural_decisions.impact: Ensures zero data loss during bot updates.
architectural_decisions.review_trigger: When adding new analytics or logging tables.

architectural_decisions.decision: Reserve the circuit-breaker HALF_OPEN trial slot at the OPEN->HALF_OPEN transition
architectural_decisions.reason: A concurrent thread could otherwise pass the transition check and believe it is the single allowed trial request, letting two requests through the half-open window.
alternatives: Accept the race and allow extra trial requests to leak through
Hold the state lock across the whole request path
architectural_decisions.impact: Guarantees at most one trial request per half-open window; verified deterministically by tests/stress.
architectural_decisions.review_trigger: If trial-request races reappear under high per-router concurrency.

architectural_decisions.decision: Keep deterministic concurrency stress tests (tests/stress) and fault-injection suites (tests/fault) with fully mocked external I/O
architectural_decisions.reason: The original time.monotonic patch-leak hang only reproduced under specific interleavings; barriers plus fully mocked I/O make it reproducible on every run and guard against regression.
alternatives: Real-socket integration tests against live routers (flaky, CI-hostile)
architectural_decisions.impact: Reproducible CI without timing-dependent sleeps; zero real stalls across the full suite (2998 passed in ~20 min).
architectural_decisions.review_trigger: When adding new concurrency-sensitive or failure-prone code paths.
